title: $\beta$-CaC$_{2}$O$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
Anhydrous CaC$_{2}$O$_{4}$ is found in three forms, but the $\beta$ form is the only one with a known structure. 
 Below 250$^\circ$C it transforms into $\alpha$CaC$_{2}$O$_{4}$, and above 410$^\circ$C it transforms into $\gamma$CaC$_{2}$O$_{4}$. 
 The data for this structure was obtained at 25$^\circ$C. 
 The AFLOW label ordering protocol rewrites the axes for this monoclinic structure, moving the C I and C II sites from Wyckoff positions (2j) and (2l) to positions (2i) and (2j).
